## Purpose
The controls on the Settings page, one tile per setting, typed by the setting definition.

## Responsibilities
- `SettingTile` uses `ValueInput`, `ModelListInput`, `SwatchPicker`, `NumericRange` (with `low_effect` / `high_effect`), `ModelWarning` / `isExcludedModel` (Codestral on code routes), `SourceChip` (override, env or default), `ModelStatusChip` and `ModelFacts`.

## Key elements
`SettingTile`, `SourceChip`, `ModelStatusChip`, `ModelFacts`.

## Control flow
React rendering; data through React Query hooks where noted.

## Data, state and side effects
None beyond component state.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- Settings definitions come from `/api/settings` (`app_settings` and the Tool Service's `runtime_settings`).

## Error handling and edge cases
None noted.

None noted.

Implement as described; copying the file is the reliable route for exact styling.
